summary: Frontend-only Phase 2B.2 validation completed. Redesigned sign-in loads, /status-compose renders, and /status-view/me shows expected empty-state without crash. Auth click opens external OIDC page in web automation, but authenticated in-app status tab flow remains unverified.

ui_bugs.component: Web deep-link route for status tab
ui_bugs.issue: Direct visit to /status renders a plain 'packager-status:running' page instead of app UI in this preview environment, so status tab route is not web-deeplink testable.

integration_issues.issue: Sign-in click opens external Hercules/OIDC page (popup detected), but full deterministic login completion in automation remains non-deterministic, blocking in-app authenticated tab regression completion.

action_items: Fix/status-check web routing for /status in preview so Expo Router screen is reachable (currently intercepted by packager-status page).
After deterministic auth completion is available in automation, retest authenticated flow: sign-in -> tabs -> status tab -> status view navigation.
Track and plan cleanup for recurring warnings: expo-av deprecation, shadow* deprecation, pointerEvents deprecation.
critical_code_review_comments: Tab file name/route 'status' appears to conflict with web preview endpoint behavior for direct /status access in this environment, creating route-level regression risk for web preview testing.

Status viewer/reply features are auth/data-dependent and currently have no deterministic automated signed-in regression path; add stable internal test hook or seeded auth test strategy for CI coverage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md first. Verified in this run: root sign-in UI stable, /status-compose stable, /status-view/me empty-state stable. Unverified due auth/deeplink limitations: full in-app status tab flow under authenticated session.
rca_of_issue: Repro for route issue: open https://smilers-chat-mobile.preview.emergentagent.com/status directly in mobile web preview; screen shows plain 'packager-status:running' instead of app route. Repro for auth gate: click [data-testid='sign-in-btn'] on root; popup page count increases (external OIDC opens), but deterministic scripted completion not guaranteed due third-party flow.
